title: Laplacian bound for a Rademacher norm
statement: Let $V$ be a real normed vector space, let $w_1,\ldots,w_n\in V$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. For the function $y\mapsto\left\|\sum_{i=1}^n y_iw_i\right\|$, its Laplacian at $x$ is at most $\left\|\sum_{i=1}^n x_iw_i\right\|$.
hypotheses_covered: A vector $w_i\in V$ for each coordinate
A point in the $n$-dimensional sign cube
